== Summary ==
Identified: [[Robbie Hendon]] (center, green Dallas Stars cap and grey shirt; same cap as [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]]), [[Bill Kafer]] (seated, grey-and-orange mountain-logo cap and Players Committee polo embroidered "Bill Kafer / Streaming Team"), and [[Chris Gogolen]] (blue-and-grey raglan and a dark mask; same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship game in progress 7.jpg]]).

Players talking between rounds. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2021:10:08 00:42:02 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-19
* '''Identification:''' [[Robbie Hendon]] (center, green Dallas Stars cap and grey shirt; same cap as [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]]), [[Bill Kafer]] (seated, grey-and-orange mountain-logo cap and Players Committee polo embroidered "Bill Kafer / Streaming Team"), and [[Chris Gogolen]] (blue-and-grey raglan and a dark mask; same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship game in progress 7.jpg]]).
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
